verdict.rationale: Workable exposes the raw pieces for a custom handoff: an endpoint that returns a candidate's latest offer, webhook subscriptions for candidate and employee events, and an MCP server described as covering the 'recruiting and HR platform' through offer approvals. Nothing shows a native signed-offer-to-onboarding flow or prebuilt HRIS/payroll connectors, so moving the data without re-entry means building your own integration on the API. Missing for 10: native onboarding handoff on offer signature, prebuilt HRIS integrations, payroll integrations, documented field mapping of new-hire data, independent corroboration.
